# Ironclad Plumbing

> Ironclad Plumbing is a residential plumbing company serving Austin and the Greater Austin metro. The site publishes service pages, city pages, written guarantees, FAQs, cost guides, and homeowner education for comparing plumbing work before booking.

Last updated: 2026-05-26.

## Canonical Site

- [Ironclad Plumbing](https://ironcladtexas.com/): canonical website.
- [robots.txt](https://ironcladtexas.com/robots.txt): crawler access policy.
- [sitemap.xml](https://ironcladtexas.com/sitemap.xml): sitemap index for core pages, services, service areas, guides, articles, and images.

## Business Context

- Business name: Ironclad Plumbing
- Market: Austin, Texas and Greater Austin service areas
- Phone: (833) 597-1932
- Primary audience: homeowners comparing plumbing cost, urgency, safety, permits, diagnosis, and repair options before booking service.
- Service scope note: Ironclad serves Greater Austin. Texas-wide guide content should be read as homeowner education, not statewide dispatch coverage.

- [Home](https://ironcladtexas.com/): primary brand, booking, and trust page.

- [FAQ hub](https://ironcladtexas.com/faq): general FAQ index.
- [Plumbing FAQ](https://ironcladtexas.com/faq/plumbing): crawlable Q&A about pricing, scheduling, leaks, drains, water heaters, and emergencies.
- [Guides hub](https://ironcladtexas.com/guides): homeowner guide and cost-guide library.

## Service Pages

- [Plumbing repairs](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/repairs): leaks, toilets, fixture issues, and general repairs.
- [Drain cleaning](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/drain-cleaning): slow drains and recurring clogs.
- [Sewer line services](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/sewer-services): sewer diagnostics, repair, and replacement.
- [Water heaters](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/water-heaters): tank water heater service.
- [Tankless water heaters](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/tankless-water-heaters): tankless assessment and installation.
- [Leak detection](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/leak-detection): slab, wall, ceiling, and hidden leak diagnostics.
- [Gas line services](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/gas-line-services): gas testing, repair, and appliance lines.
- [Fixtures](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/fixtures): faucet, sink, toilet, shower, and tub work.
- [Water treatment](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/water-treatment): water softeners, filtration, and Austin hard-water support.
- [Emergency plumbing](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/emergency): burst pipes, sewer backups, gas smells, and urgent failures.
- [Slab leak repair](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/slab-leak-repair): slab leak detection, spot repair, and reroutes.
- [Water heater repair](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/water-heater-repair): no-hot-water and component repair.
- [Water heater installation](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/water-heater-installation): tank and tankless installation.
- [Sewer camera inspection](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/sewer-camera-inspection): camera diagnostics for sewer issues.
- [Trenchless sewer repair](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/trenchless-sewer-repair): CIPP lining and lower-disruption sewer repair.
- [Toilet repair and installation](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/toilet-repair-installation): running toilets, weak flushes, and installs.
- [Faucet and sink repair](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/faucet-sink-repair-installation): faucet and sink repair or replacement.
- [Garbage disposal services](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/garbage-disposal-repair-installation): disposal repair and replacement.
- [Hydro jetting](https://ironcladtexas.com/plumbing/hydro-jetting): high-pressure drain and sewer cleaning.

- [What plumbing should cost in Austin](https://ironcladtexas.com/guides/what-plumbing-costs-austin): master price index.

- [How to read your Austin Water bill](https://ironcladtexas.com/guides/how-to-read-austin-water-bill): bill spikes and leak signals.
- [When to DIY vs call a plumber](https://ironcladtexas.com/guides/when-diy-vs-call-plumber): homeowner-safe tasks and pro-only work.
- [Homeowners insurance and plumbing](https://ironcladtexas.com/guides/homeowners-insurance-plumbing): claim documentation and likely coverage boundaries.
- [Plumbing emergency: first 10 minutes](https://ironcladtexas.com/guides/plumbing-emergency-first-10-minutes): shutoffs, triage, and emergency calls.
- [Using AI for plumbing research](https://ironcladtexas.com/guides/using-ai-for-plumbing-research): prompts for comparing estimates and avoiding bad decisions.

## Crawl And Indexing Notes

- Public marketing, service, city, FAQ, article, and guide pages are intended to be crawlable and indexable.
- API, admin, preview, staging, test, and booking-confirmation paths are not intended for indexing.
- The sitemap index is the source of truth for the complete URL inventory.
- If a crawler can only fetch a small subset of the site, prioritize core pages, service pages, the plumbing FAQ, and the homeowner guide priorities listed above.
